disasters.summary: Drought affecting parts of northern South America and the Panama Isthmus, according to GDACS, with a reported start in late February 2026. In Colombia, extreme drought has hit parts of Cundinamarca, where November rainfall fell 96%. Panama's government declared a national state of emergency on 25 August. The drought is ongoing as of late November 2026, and no end date is reported.

disasters.summary: Drought in East Africa and the Central Sahel, with the alert dated from 21 May 2026; that start date is not confirmed by the sources reviewed. As of 26 November 2026, FEWS NET and NOAA CPC report persistent dryness in East Africa and the Horn of Africa. No November 2026 source covers the Central Sahel. The notes give no death or displacement totals. Ethiopia reports over 3.5 million people affected (IFRC GO, September 2026).

disasters.summary: A drought linked to El Niño has affected Central America since spring 2026, with crop failures and food insecurity reported across the region. Guatemala's agriculture ministry reported 708,469 families affected in 13 departments on 24 November. Honduras declared a drought emergency on 19 August, and El Salvador has been on nationwide red alert since 25 August. Impacts are continuing, and El Niño is still intensifying.

disasters.summary: Drought across much of Europe began on 21 Dec 2025 and remains ongoing as of 28 Nov 2026. JRC and Copernicus reports said it stayed critical through October and early November, worsening in the Iberian Peninsula. Moisture reached affected areas in mid-November, but drought remains in Western Europe. No end date has been reported.

disasters.summary: Severe flash floods struck parts of central Nepal on 26 August 2026, affecting communities along the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli river corridors in Rasuwa and nearby districts. Reported death tolls differ between sources. The latest dated report found is an IFRC operations update of 12 October 2026, which describes ongoing rehabilitation and assessment work.

disasters.title: Indonesia: East Nusa Tenggara Earthquake
disasters.summary: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck off Nagekeo Regency, East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia, on 15 August 2026 at 04:58 WIB. Damage was reported to buildings in Nagekeo and Bima. Reports cite 100 deaths and more than 5,000 people in evacuation shelters. The research tool failed, so these figures come from source headlines, and no later status was found.

disasters.summary: Monsoon flooding in Myanmar from July 2026 affected Sagaing, Rakhine, Ayeyarwady, and Kachin states. Ministry figures reported more than 11,400 people in relief centres in Sagaing by 11 August. A UNICEF brief using end-August figures reported about 600,000 people affected. An IFRC DREF operation started 12 August 2026. No source confirms the flood status as of 28 November 2026.

summarySource.name: Myanmar 2026 Monsoon Emergency Response Supporting Children and Families

disasters.title: Colombia - Earthquake
disasters.summary: A magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck near San José del Palmar, Chocó, Colombia, on 10 August 2026. The latest official UNGRD figures, dated 10 October 2026, report 335 deaths, 4,516 injured and 103 missing. Recovery work was still under way in October. The notes do not say whether the emergency is still active on 27 November 2026.
